metaData.title: Skill Factory: Build a Harness-Designed Skill Factory in Three Days (with AI Coding Practice)
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article introduces the Skill Factory built by Alibaba Cloud developers based on the Test-Driven Development (TDD) concept. It achieves a standardized, high-reliability skill generation pipeline for Harness design through multi-path parallel generation, automated test regression, and ecosystem adaptation.
metaData.summary: Starting from the author's full-stack development practice with AI coding assistance, this article analyzes the pain points of two current mainstream skill generation methods (manual writing and conversational generation): low efficiency, high quality fluctuation, and lack of an automated verification closed loop. To address these issues, the author proposes the Skill Factory solution, with the core idea being 'Test-Driven Skill Generation.' This solution comprises four key stages: baseline diagnosis (evaluating whether the bare model and existing skills meet requirements), multi-path parallel generation (invoking multiple strategies/models in parallel to generate skills, improving the first-time success rate), automated test regression (scoring and optimizing from dimensions such as format specification, reuse innovation, and functional availability), and quality inspection. Additionally, the article introduces ecosystem adaptation with the Zhiliu platform and an iterative direction based on Trace2Skill, aiming to precipitate reusable skills from execution traces. Finally, the author shares practical experiences using AI coding tools (such as idealab, Qoderwork, Aimashi, and Lingma) for auxiliary design during development and compares the pros and cons of the three skill generation modes.
metaData.featuredReason: This article introduces a "Skill Factory" designed for Harness, addressing the efficiency and quality challenges of manual and interactive LLM-based skill generation. It details a standardized, test-driven approach with parallel generation and automated iterative refinement, significantly boosting skill production efficiency and code quality. The author also shares practical experiences using AI coding tools during development.

mainPoints.point: Current skill generation modes have core defects such as low efficiency, uncontrollable quality, and a lack of engineering verification.
mainPoints.explanation: Manual writing is limited by personal experience, resulting in low efficiency and high quality fluctuation. Conversational generation, while fast, is essentially a non-deterministic exploration process lacking an automated verification closed loop, making it difficult to ensure stability and production-grade quality.

mainPoints.point: Skill Factory adopts a 'Test-Driven Generation' pipeline, achieving standardized production through baseline diagnosis, multi-path concurrency, and automated regression.
mainPoints.explanation: First, assess the capability gap between the bare model and existing skills. Then, invoke multiple strategies in parallel to generate skills. Finally, use automated testing to score and iteratively optimize from multiple dimensions, ensuring a high lower bound and reliability for the skills.

mainPoints.point: The multi-path parallel generation strategy is a key design for improving the first-time success rate.
mainPoints.explanation: By invoking three Creators with different strategies in parallel, it's like buying three lottery tickets with different numbers at once. As long as one path generates high-quality code, the entire task is considered successful, effectively avoiding repeated retries caused by the failure of a single path.

mainPoints.point: Future iteration directions include large-scale skill mining from execution traces based on Trace2Skill and introducing reinforcement learning for deeper regression optimization.
mainPoints.explanation: Referencing the Trace2Skill method from the Qwen team, it transforms the implicit experience of agents into explicit skill documents. This is expected to enable large-scale skill production and screening, further enhancing the stability of agents in executing long-term tasks.

keyQuotes: Although Mode 2 improves coding speed, it is still essentially a non-deterministic exploration process, lacking an automated verification closed loop and engineering constraints.

By invoking three Creators with different strategies (or different models/different Prompt templates) in parallel, it's like buying three lottery tickets with different numbers at once. Result: As long as one path generates high-quality code, the entire task is considered successful.
The essence of Trace2Skill is to transform the 'implicit experience' of agents (a large number of specific execution traces) into 'explicit knowledge' (structured skill documents).

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: Deep Dive: The Memory Architecture and Philosophy That Thousands of Words Can't Fully Explain

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Hermes in One Article: How the New Top-Tier Agent Self-Evolves from Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the core innovation of the Hermes Agent—the Skills closed-loop system—detailing its complete implementation mechanism, from experience extraction and knowledge storage to intelligent retrieval and self-improvement, along with its engineering trade-offs and security considerations.

relatedArticles.title: From Toy to Productivity: Demystifying AI Agent Harness Engineering Through Real Projects
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the practical experience of the real-world project Aegis, this article systematically elaborates on the concept, architectural boundaries, and implementation methods of Harness Engineering. It argues that in enterprise engineering environments, constraining and governing non-deterministic large models by building a control plane is the key to transforming AI Agents from toys into productive tools, and it drives the migration of the engineer's role from code executor to goal controller.

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically reviews the evolutionary trajectory of AI Agents from monolithic to multi-agent, then to Skills pluginization and Teams parallel collaboration, and, drawing on the latest research from Google and Anthropic, provides a scientific methodology for selection.
